issues.summary: restoreWeekFromHealBackup_ (line 1933) deletes ALL live Summary rows for the week BEFORE checking the snapshot is non-empty. When Summary_heal_backup holds no snapshot for that week - the state of every week never healed, i.e. all ~169 pre-existing weeks - it destroys the week's Summary and restores nothing, then returns {restored:0} and logs 'restored 0 row(s)', which reads as a benign no-op. Proven with a probe: 2 rows / $350 in, 0 rows / $0 out. There is no delete path back (upsertRows_ only appends/setValues), and TODO.md:64-70 names this the ONLY data undo. Needs an early return when snapshotRows is empty (plus a null guard on summSheet). Also has zero test coverage and zero callers.

The 3am rollback runbook (lines 61-63) states SUMMARY_HEAL_ENABLED=false 'stops the self-heal write immediately'. It does not. summaryHealWindowSize_ (Code.gs:2253) returns 1 when the switch is off, and weeklySummarize_impl_ still routes that one week through healWeeks_ -> healWeek_ -> upsertRows_. The suite asserts the write happens ('switch OFF: wk-1 is healed', test_code.js:8231, 100 -> 175.25). Code.gs's own comment is accurate ('off means 1 - today's single-week behaviour, now guarded'); TODO.md contradicts it. An operator flipping the documented emergency switch mid-incident will still get Summary writes.

The FIX5 regression test ('healEarliestBackupRows_ is either called by production code or removed', line ~9200) passes vacuously. Its only caller is restoreWeekFromHealBackup_, which itself has no callers, no tests and no doc reference - so the guard is satisfied by one dead function calling another and cannot detect the dead-code condition it was written to catch. The test should assert reachability from a live entry point, not mere textual reference.

The 'Labour correction' alert (weeklySummarize_impl_, ~line 2330) fires whenever labourResult.summaryAdded + summaryUpdated > 0. summaryAdded counts brand-new rows, so an ordinary first-time labour insert for a fresh week trips it on every scheduled run - a weekly calendar event labelled 'correction' when nothing was corrected. Gate on summaryUpdated (or upsertRows_'s new updates array) instead. 'Labour correction' has 0 references in test_code.js.

Carried step 6 concern, still unaddressed. staleness.gs:18 and :277 claim this file is 'THE ONLY SOURCE OF THE CalendarApp OAuth SCOPE' / 'the ONLY functions in the project that touch CalendarApp', but orderapp.gs:176 and :212 still call CalendarApp.EventColor.ORANGE directly. The FIX1 test7 comment says 'no file other than staleness.gs references CalendarApp' while the assertion only reads Code.gs (test_code.js:9190-9192), so orderapp.gs is never checked. No functional impact (the scope is granted either way), but the invariant comment is false and step 6's brief required a TODO.md note that was not written.

healOrphanCandidates_ lacks the auditPurgeCutoff_ guard that summaryOrphanSweep_ (summary_audit.gs) applies. On a manual weeklySummarize('<old-week>') override for a week past the 183-day purge line, neither Suppliers nor _archive holds the source rows, so the recompute is empty and every live Summary row is reported as an orphan candidate - while the sweep, which is correctly windowed, will always refuse to act on them. Alert names rows the removal path cannot touch. Scheduled runs are unaffected (they only touch the last 4 weeks).
